question.:question/problem: Which of the following parametric equations, defined for $\theta \in [0,2\pi ),$ generate a circle of radius $15$ centered at the origin?
question.:question/worked-solution:
The parametric equations of a circle  of radius $r$  centered at  the origin are

$$
x=r\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta ,\,y=r\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta ,\,\theta \in [0,2\pi ).
$$

In our case, the radius $r=15.$ Therefore, the parametric equations of the circle are 

$$
x=15\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta ,\,y=15\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta ,\,\theta \in [0,2\pi ).
$$

Consider the circle of radius $5$ centered at the origin, as shown above. Which of the following sets of parametric equations, defined for $\theta \in [0,2\pi ),$  traverse the circle once in the counterclockwise direction starting at the point $A(5,0)?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The parametric equations of a circle  of radius $r$ centered at  the origin are

$$
x=r\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta ,\,y=r\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta ,\,\theta \in [0,2\pi ).
$$

Under this parametrization, the circle is traversed once in the counterclockwise direction, starting from $(r,0).$

In our case, the radius $r=5.$ Therefore, the parametric equations of the circle are 

$$
x=5\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta ,\,y=5\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta ,\,\theta \in [0,2\pi ).
$$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/generate/scratch/17592186087742/assets/circle-06998a9f7c3bd272.png)

Consider the circle of radius $29$ centered at the origin, as shown above. Which of the following sets of parametric equations, defined for $\theta \in [0,2\pi ),$  traverse the circle once in the counterclockwise direction starting at the point $A(29,0)?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The parametric equations of a circle  of radius $r$ centered at  the origin are

$$
x=r\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta ,\,y=r\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta ,\,\theta \in [0,2\pi ).
$$

Under this parametrization, the circle is traversed once in the counterclockwise direction, starting from $(r,0).$

In our case, the radius $r=29.$ Therefore, the parametric equations of the circle are 

$$
x=29\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta ,\,y=29\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta ,\,\theta \in [0,2\pi ).
$$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/generate/scratch/17592186087742/assets/circle-17eed2c0e7c9788d.png)

Consider the circle of radius $16$ centered at the origin, as shown above. Which of the following sets of parametric equations, defined for $\theta \in [0,2\pi ),$  traverse the circle once in the counterclockwise direction starting at the point $A(16,0)?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The parametric equations of a circle  of radius $r$ centered at  the origin are

$$
x=r\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta ,\,y=r\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta ,\,\theta \in [0,2\pi ).
$$

Under this parametrization, the circle is traversed once in the counterclockwise direction, starting from $(r,0).$

In our case, the radius $r=16.$ Therefore, the parametric equations of the circle are 

$$
x=16\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta ,\,y=16\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta ,\,\theta \in [0,2\pi ).
$$
